name: starshipit-mcp
description: Manage StarShipIt orders, shipments, labels, tracking, rates, manifests, address book and products

tools.name: starshipit_list_unshipped_orders
tools.description: List unshipped orders from StarShipIt. Returns orders that have been imported but not yet shipped.

tools.name: starshipit_list_printed_orders
tools.description: List printed (label generated) orders from StarShipIt. Use this to review orders where labels have been printed but may not yet be manifested.

tools.name: starshipit_list_shipped_orders
tools.description: List shipped orders from StarShipIt. Returns orders that have been manifested and dispatched to the carrier.

tools.name: starshipit_list_delivered_orders
tools.description: List delivered orders from StarShipIt. Returns orders where the carrier has confirmed delivery.

tools.name: starshipit_get_orders_summary
tools.description: Get a summary of orders filtered by status from StarShipIt. Useful for dashboards and reporting.

tools.name: starshipit_search_orders
tools.description: Search orders in StarShipIt by a free-text phrase. Searches across order numbers, references, recipient names, tracking numbers, and other indexed fields.

tools.name: starshipit_get_order
tools.description: Retrieve a single order from StarShipIt by its internal ID or merchant order number. At least one of `order_id` or `order_number` must be supplied.

tools.name: starshipit_create_order
tools.description: Create a new order in StarShipIt. The order will appear in the unshipped queue ready for label generation.

tools.name: starshipit_create_orders_bulk
tools.description: Import multiple orders into StarShipIt in a single API call. Use this for batch fulfilment import from external systems.

tools.name: starshipit_update_order
tools.description: Update an existing unshipped order in StarShipIt. Only fields provided in the payload will be updated; others remain unchanged (partial patch semantics).

tools.name: starshipit_update_orders_bulk
tools.description: Update multiple existing orders in StarShipIt in a single API call. Each entry must include `order_id`; other fields are optional partial updates.

tools.name: starshipit_batch_update_orders
tools.description: Apply the same carrier or shipping service product to a batch of orders in StarShipIt. Use this to reassign carrier/service for multiple orders in a single call.

tools.name: starshipit_delete_order
tools.description: Permanently delete an order from StarShipIt. This action is irreversible — the order will be removed from the system entirely.

tools.name: starshipit_archive_order
tools.description: Archive an order in StarShipIt. Archived orders are hidden from the main fulfilment queue but remain in the system and can be restored at any time.

tools.name: starshipit_restore_order
tools.description: Restore a previously archived order in StarShipIt, returning it to the active fulfilment queue.

tools.name: starshipit_merge_orders
tools.description: Merge one or more child orders into a parent order in StarShipIt. After merging, the child orders are absorbed into the parent and the combined shipment will be dispatched as a single package.

tools.name: starshipit_get_suggested_merges
tools.description: Get a list of orders that StarShipIt suggests can be merged — typically orders from the same customer with the same destination address. Use this before calling `starshipit_merge_orders` to identify candidates.

tools.name: starshipit_assign_orders
tools.description: Reassign orders between StarShipIt accounts using API keys. Use this to move orders from one StarShipIt sub-account or warehouse account to another.

tools.name: starshipit_print_label
tools.description: Print (or reprint) a shipping label for a single order in StarShipIt.

tools.name: starshipit_print_labels
tools.description: Print shipping labels for multiple orders at once in StarShipIt.

tools.name: starshipit_print_packing_slips
tools.description: Generate packing slip documents for one or more orders in StarShipIt.

tools.name: starshipit_manifest_shipment
tools.description: Manifest (finalise/close) shipments by order IDs in StarShipIt.

tools.name: starshipit_clone_shipment
tools.description: Clone an existing shipment in StarShipIt, optionally converting it to a return shipment.

tools.name: starshipit_replace_shipment
tools.description: Replace an existing shipment in StarShipIt — voids the previous label and creates a new one.

tools.name: starshipit_track_shipment
tools.description: Track a shipment by tracking number using StarShipIt.

tools.name: starshipit_create_tracking_order
tools.description: Create tracking-only orders in StarShipIt for shipments dispatched outside the platform.

tools.name: starshipit_get_rates
tools.description: Get available shipping rates (quotes) for a shipment between a sender and destination address with the given package dimensions.

tools.name: starshipit_get_delivery_services
tools.description: Get available delivery services (carrier + service options) for a specific order or a general route. Returns service codes that are directly usable when creating or updating orders.

tools.name: starshipit_list_addresses
tools.description: List saved addresses from the StarShipIt address book, with optional text filtering and pagination.

tools.name: starshipit_add_address
tools.description: Add a new address entry to the StarShipIt address book for reuse in future orders.

tools.name: starshipit_update_address
tools.description: Update an existing address book entry by its ID.

tools.name: starshipit_delete_addresses
tools.description: Delete one or more addresses from the StarShipIt address book by their IDs. This action is permanent and cannot be undone.

tools.name: starshipit_list_manifests
tools.description: List all manifests in your StarShipIt account.

tools.name: starshipit_get_manifest_files
tools.description: Retrieve manifest documents (PDF, XML, etc.) as base64 file content.

tools.name: starshipit_manifest_by_tracking
tools.description: Manifest (close/submit) specific shipments to the carrier by their tracking numbers or order numbers.

tools.name: starshipit_manifest_by_carrier
tools.description: Manifest ALL unmanifested shipments for a specific carrier in one operation.

tools.name: starshipit_list_products
tools.description: List or search products in the StarShipIt product catalogue.

tools.name: starshipit_add_product
tools.description: Add a new product to the StarShipIt product catalogue.

tools.name: starshipit_update_product
tools.description: Update an existing product in the StarShipIt product catalogue by its numeric ID.

tools.name: starshipit_delete_products
tools.description: Delete one or more products from the StarShipIt product catalogue. This operation is irreversible.
